parts.title: Writing Task 1
parts.passage:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The maps below show changes to a farm site from 1950 to the present day.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

questions.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features. Write at least 150 words.
questions.content: <textarea data-qid='1' class='ielts-textarea' rows='15' placeholder='Type your Task 1 response here...'></textarea>
questions.answer: Model answer not applicable for writing tasks.

parts.title: Writing Task 2
parts.passage:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

Some people think that school children should have long holidays, while others believe that shorter holidays throughout the year are better.

Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questions.instruction: Discuss the topic in depth. Write at least 250 words.
questions.content: <textarea data-qid='2' class='ielts-textarea' rows='20' placeholder='Type your Task 2 response here...'></textarea>
questions.answer: Model answer not applicable for writing tasks.
